description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the Acquisition of the Land in Bloemaendhal, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2129/85 of 27.06.2019 Weerambugedara D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns land acquisition and compensation matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically deals with compensation payments for land parcels that were vested in the Government, provides details about the specific land (location, plan numbers, extent), and informs the public about claiming compensation through the District Court. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative procedures, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
